Allen attended [[St. Stephen's Episcopal School (Austin, Texas)|St. Stephen's Episcopal School]] in [[Austin, Texas]].[http://www.mystatesman.com/sports/high-school/stephen-allen-foresees-fun-filled-basketball-career/NZNWaWY4TRmpbB8AdRRjBN/ St. Stephen’s Allen foresees a fun-filled basketball career] He played in the [[2016 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].[http://preps.blog.statesman.com/2016/01/17/mcdonalds-all-american-game-to-feature-st-stephens-standout/ McDonald’s All American game to feature St. Stephen’s standout] He committed to the [[University of Texas at Austin]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://www.hookem.com/2016/06/03/draft-jarrett-allen-coming-texas/ The wait is over: Jarrett Allen is coming to Texas][http://www.expressnews.com/sports/college_sports/longhorns/article/Texas-lands-elite-hoops-recruit-in-Allen-7962368.php Texas lands elite hoops recruit in Allen] As a freshman at Texas, Allen averaged 13.4 points and 8.4 rebounds per game.
